paper.title: MemoTime: Memory-Augmented Temporal Knowledge Graph Enhanced Large Language Model Reasoning
paper.central_claim: 以时间约束 grounding、Tree of Time 分解、算子感知检索和持续写回的经验记忆，在无需权重训练下提升时序知识图谱问答，并通过复用经验持续改进。

provenance.notes: Opus aggregate seat via the configured claude-kimi type fable; no route probing. actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref are null because the subagent runtime exposes no verifiable provider receipt to this worker.

sections_read: Opus: complete pinned text read end-to-end (abstract, all sections, tables, appendices) before opening seat records; targeted re-reads for every disputed field

evidence.locator: §1; temporal KGQA limitations, lines 2827–2829 reiterated in §5.1
evidence.quote: LLM-based methods, e.g, KG-RAG, ReAct KB, ARI, TempAgent, leverage prompt reasoning but remain sensitive to implicit time expressions and struggle with multi-constraint temporal alignment.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者将问题定位于隐式时间表达及跨约束对齐，而不只是冻结权重。此为本文对邻居的陈述，非原论文独立核查。

evidence.quote:
At runtime, it acts as a shared repository for experience-guided decomposition, toolkit selection, and answer synthesis.
After each reasoning session, verified results, including embeddings, type labels, sufficiency status, and hit statistics, are
propagated back into memory, updating both the long-term index and the fast-access buffer.
evidence.support_explanation: 明确保留的是非权重经验池，结果写回长期索引与缓存，并供后续推理读取，符合范围；不能仅因作者称 verified 就推定有独立验证器。

evidence.quote: For each node in the reasoning tree, the LLM assesses retrieved temporal paths for both semantic relevance and temporal validity.
evidence.support_explanation: 关键语义/时间充分性判断由 LLM 做；图查询执行的存在不等于独立答案正确性门控。

evidence.quote: The incorrect samples are used as warnings.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者还使用错误样本提示，但未据此证明噪声门控或错误传播已量化。

evidence.quote: obsolete or low-value traces are periodically pruned to prevent redundancy.
evidence.support_explanation: 声明了清理维护，但阈值、周期和版本/回退协议未具体到可重建；故只是部分落实。

evidence.quote:
To analyse the role of continual learning, we remove the experience memory module, preventing MemoTime from accessing previously verified reasoning traces.
The result in Table
4
shows it causes a moderate performance drop from 64.2% to 59.8%, with larger reductions observed on multi-hop questions, from 40.3% to 26.1%.
evidence.support_explanation: 相同 GPT-4o-mini 系统中去记忆降低 4.4 个百分点，支持局部记忆贡献；不是独立构建/冻结记忆后的留出迁移实验。

evidence.quote: When embedding-based retrieval is removed, the performance decreases moderately from 64.2% to 60.1%, suggesting that semantic retrieval complements the graph search by capturing lexically diverse or contextually implicit temporal cues.
evidence.support_explanation: 有组件开关，但未分离索引组织、门控与动态写回的各自作用。

evidence.quote: MemoTime with GPT-4-Turbo achieves an overall 77.9% Hit@1, surpassing TempAgent by 24.0% and outperforming all GPT-3.5 baselines by a large margin.
evidence.support_explanation: 给出任务结果，但 GPT-4 与 GPT-3.5 比较不能独立归因给记忆或分解；24.0 是绝对百分点。

evidence.quote: For each baseline, we adopt the reported performance values from their original publications to ensure comparability under consistent evaluation settings.
evidence.support_explanation: 基线来自原文报告，未共同重跑匹配预算；不能把作者的 comparability 宣称当作已验证事实。

evidence.quote:
we use
exact match accuracy
(Hits@1) as the principal evaluation metric.
evidence.support_explanation: 正式外部问答标签的 Hits@1 与任务成功匹配；独立于模型内部的 sufficiency 判别。

evidence.quote:
All experiences are dynamically learned from verified reasoning traces, with five predefined exemplars used for cold-start initialization.
The database buffer size is set to 200 for efficiency.
evidence.support_explanation: 披露冷启动及缓存容量，但未限定动态经验来自哪些拆分、任务顺序、是否测试内累积。

M.reason: Opus sides with sol. M judges the whole method against its four stated problems: monotone time filtering, co-constrained multi-entity paths, operator toolkits and typed experience reuse each target a named failure and make distinguishable predictions that the ablations test (multi-entity 40.3→23.5 without graph retrieval, →19.3 without the tree). son55's 2 rests on the memory sub-mechanism alone ('why accumulated exemplars beat fixed ones is asserted'), which is a valid weakness but one component of the method; it is kept in X/E.causality.
